A.description: AlbSL fingerspelling letter 'A'. Contains 17 annotated hand pose samples. Use 'representative.landmarks' for fast nearest-neighbour matching or 'statistics.median_pose' for a robust reference. All coordinate values in 'x_norm/y_norm/z_norm' fields are wrist-centered and scale-normalised to [-1,+1].

coordinate_system.scale: Divided by max absolute coordinate → range [-1, +1]
coordinate_system.z_axis: Depth estimate from MediaPipe (positive = toward camera)
